{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the sales data with proper parsing of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify that refunded orders are still in the dataset
print(sales_df['status'].value_counts())

# Filter to only completed orders for conversion rate calculation
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of customer_segment in completed orders
print(completed_orders['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Calculate conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = completed_orders.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print(conversion_rates)

# Identify the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

print(f"Best segment: {best_segment}, Conversion rate: {best_rate}")"}
